mcq_drop.why: contrived A/R on climate elements, off-topic for air masses; no exam pairs these

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: air pollution / winter temperature inversion

patterns: PYQs here are thin and indirect: polar vortex (role: keeps cold air north), Tornado Alley (Mississippi plains where mT and cP meet).
Expect direct single-fact items: Bergeron code letters (c/m = moisture; T/P/A/E = source), source region of cT/cP/mT/mP.
Front weather contrasts (cold = steep, short heavy showers; warm = gentle, prolonged rain; occluded = last stage) are the likely trap.
App leans heavily on match/statement/A-R formats and adds generic climate-element items; APPSC asks this topic far less and more simply.
